name: scrub-field

frames.best_why: Radius chip is mid-scrub with a +22 bubble and the preview showing a wide soft shadow.

tagline: Drag a number chip sideways to scrub its value, with a live change bubble.
summary: A compact settings row of labelled number chips. Dragging a chip sideways changes its value, a bubble shows the change, and clicking the number lets you type an exact amount.
appearance: A dark rounded panel headed SHADOW holds three stacked chips, each with a small label at the left and a right-aligned number with a unit. Beside it a rounded preview square casts a soft shadow that follows the values; while dragging, a small white bubble floats above the chip.
behaviour: Pulling a chip sideways scrubs its number, easing past the limits with a rubber band and springing back on release while the bubble tracks the change. A plain click focuses the digits so you can type a value and confirm with Enter.
demo_content: Shadow settings Radius 16px, Blur 24px, Opacity 80%, next to a Preview square.
search_phrases: scrub control to change a value
click to type a number value
use_when: A settings or inspector panel needs precise numbers that are also quick to nudge by dragging.
avoid_when: Chips are fixed-width and dark by default, so they need colour props and overrides to fit a light toolbar.
customise: Label, suffix, value, range, step, size, sensitivity, rubber reach, colours and the delta, fill and dirty toggles are props; the internal layout is fixed.
weight_why: Three chips with motion values; work happens only during a drag.

a11y.note: The number field is a spinbutton with full key support, but the focused input has no visible outline.

issues: The number input, which is the keyboard entry point, has no visible focus ring.
polish_why: The scrub feel, delta bubble and rubber limits are well judged and readable.
title: Scrub Field
